archetypes.name: dyn-kv-cli
archetypes.rationale: The new kv helper is used in shell command substitutions where stdout purity matters.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the kv get CLI helper and dispatcher registration. Verify duplicate-key behavior, default handling, file versus stdin behavior, and quiet-mode protection for command substitutions. Check that the release, pause, and deps prompt call sites preserve their prior parsing semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
